title: Bhardwaj (2026). SuperLocalMemory V3: Information-Geometric Foundations for Zero-LLM Enterprise Agent Memory.
senal_calidad: Numbers from Table4/5 (LoCoMo ablation, Sec7); RECONSIDERAR -- a single independent-researcher arXiv preprint making grandiose proven-theorem claims (Fisher metric, sheaf cohomology, Langevin dynamics) validated on only six conversations plus one n=81 cloud test, no peer review.

title: Singhal (2026). ForgetAgent: Verifiable Deletion in Multi-Layer Memory Architectures for LLM Agents.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: published in IJRASET (a low-selectivity engineering journal), single author affiliated with 'Empros International School, Pune' (a secondary school), suggesting a student paper rather than a standard peer-reviewed venue -- despite a well-formalized threat model (S III).

title: Yu et al. (2026). Shopping Companion: Benchmarking and Training LLM Agents for Long-Horizon Preference-Grounded E-Commerce Tasks.
senal_calidad: Tabla 2 (Sec.6.2, p.7) resultados principales; Tabla 3 (Sec.6.3) ablation de user-simulator; Tabla 4 metricas de comportamiento con/sin tool-wise reward. Sin RECONSIDERAR: paper mide retrieval de memoria de dialogo con embeddings, consistente con F=RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO.

title: Suryadi (2026). Omni Axis Tree (OAT): A Clustered Hierarchical Data Structure for Multi-Context Retrieval with O(1) Indexed Access, and Mnemo: An AI Agent Memory System Based Thereon.
senal_calidad: Ancla: Tabla 2/3 (p.13-14, OAT vs DAG/lineal) y §12.4 (p.14-15, vs RAG vectorial); preprint de un solo autor con patente pendiente (Panaxon AI), sin peer review, y la comparación OAT-vs-RAG mide problemas distintos (lookup exacto vs retrieval semántico) — RECONSIDERAR rigor/aplicabilidad.

title: Yazir (2026). SNT-MEM: Operator-Structured Memory Management Framework for Self-Regulating AI Systems.
senal_calidad: Tablas 2-5 son SOLO simulacion sintetica (1024 slots, sin datos ni tarea real); la Sec.4.2 'real-world' es 1 modelo x 1 benchmark con F1 -2.2%. Autor unico, sin financiamiento, formalismo CPTP/cuantico pesado sobre mecanica de cache/poda/compresion convencional -- RECONSIDERAR (rigor bajo); ademas aparente DUPLICADO de W7147524247 (mismo titulo, 'Yazir' vs 'Yazir' con diacritico, numeros ligeramente distintos).

title: Carbonell Martinez (2026). SOMA: Sovereign Operative Memory Architecture -- A Cognitive Operating System for Long-Horizon Autonomous Agents.
senal_calidad: Ancla de evidencia: Sec.3.2 formula Pm + Fig.2 trayectoria TinyC; Tabla 2 resultados Perft; Tabla 4 desglose de costo. Autor unico independiente (github.com/mcarbonell/soma), solo 2 benchmarks Leviathan corridos (n=1 cada uno, sin baseline comparativo); Sec.6 son 6 direcciones de investigacion PROPUESTAS, no evaluadas -- RECONSIDERAR (evidencia empirica delgada pese a arquitectura detallada).

title: Yazır (2026). SNT-MEM: Operator-Structured Memory Management Framework for Self-Regulating AI Systems.
senal_calidad: Version extendida con apendice de reproducibilidad (codigo completo de simulacion, Sec.9) y discusion explicita de brecha teoria-implementacion (Sec.8.2) y modos de falla (Sec.8.3). RECONSIDERAR: aparente DUPLICADO de W7141308334 (mismo titulo, mismo autor, numeros de reduccion vs Mem0-style distintos entre versiones: -22.3% vs -52.8%).

title: Fofadiya & Tiwari (2026). Multi-Layered Memory Architectures for LLM Agents: An Experimental Evaluation of Long-Term Context Retention.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR -- Table II/III attribute an SR of 42.00 to Hu et al. under a 'LOCOMO' column, yet the paper's own Literature Review (Sec II) describes that number as coming from Blocksworld/Gripper/Tyreworld/Barman/Jericho task-planning benchmarks, not LOCOMO; the paper also defines three near-identically-named benchmarks (LOCOMO/LOCCO/LoCoMo) and compares against numbers cited from many unrelated papers as if directly comparable -- evidentiary rigor is doubtful.

title: Mayank and Nath (2026). Orchestrating Intelligence: A Framework for Dynamic Task Decomposition and Role Specialization in Multi-Agent Generative AI Systems.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR -- published in a low-selectivity outlet (Advanced International Journal for Research), reported deltas (23.4%/31.7%/etc.) are suspiciously round and internally tidy with no code/artifact release; treat numbers with caution.

title: Jiang et al. (2026). GBQA: A Game Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs as Quality Assurance Engineers.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR -- the paper's core contribution is a bug-discovery benchmark for QA agents (ICLR 2026 workshop), not agent-memory research; the hierarchical memory module is only a component of the baseline agent (Sec4.2), not the paper's object of study.

title: Pelissero-Witoslawski et al. (2026). Evaluating the Long-Term Memory Capabilities of Widely Deployed Large Language Model APIs.
senal_calidad: Ancla de evidencia: Tablas 1-3 (accuracy por categoria/modelo), Tabla 4 (KU/TR macro-micro), Tabla 5 (timing 500 requests, Sec.4.3). Autores independientes (Aphelior), muestra Anthropic Opus excluido por resultados casi-nulos no explicados -- RECONSIDERAR (posible problema de integracion no resuelto).

title: Halak (2026). NLM: Neural Long Memory — Hybrid Long-Term Memory for AI Agents.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR -- a single independent-researcher pip-package write-up (a marketing-style paper for 'neural-long-memory') validated only on a tiny, self-constructed benchmark (100 memories, 30 queries), not on any standard dataset like LoCoMo; the author explicitly acknowledges this scope limitation (Sec5.2).

title: Tanguturi (2026). ATANT v1.1: Positioning Continuity Evaluation Against Memory, Long-Context, and Agentic-Memory Benchmarks.
senal_calidad: Table 1 property-coverage matrix Sec 3, Sec 2.1 LOCOMO matcher-bug artifact, Sec 5 limitations (arXiv:2604.10981v2). RECONSIDERAR - single-author self-published critique evaluating the author's own commercial benchmark/product, no third-party peer reproduction of the ATANT score.

title: Li et al. (2026). CodeTracer: Towards Traceable Agent States.
senal_calidad: Numbers from Table3 (main localization results) and Table4 (ablation) plus Fig.6 (replay); RECONSIDERAR -- this is fundamentally an agent-tracing/debugging benchmark paper (traceable execution state for SWE agents), with only WRITE+CONSOLIDACION as memory operations; its 'persistent memory' is a hierarchical trace tree of past actions, not an agent long-term memory system in the sense of the rest of this corpus.

title: Sharma (2026). ContextDB: A Unified Context Layer for AI Agents -- Replacing the Patchwork with a Memory Operating System.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: a design/vision white paper (not an empirical study) synthesizing 200+ other papers' ideas, with company-affiliated author email (saaslabs.co) and only aspirational target metrics in the abstract, not measured results -- worth human review despite a well-organized architecture (S3, Table 1).

title: Sritharan, T. (2026). Agent Brain: A Biologically Inspired Memory System for Autonomous AI Agents -- LongMemEval-M Evaluation.
senal_calidad: Ancla de evidencia: Abstract y Sec.15 (regresion de consolidacion -1.9pp), Sec.4 (formula Perception Gate), Sec.14 (metricas de produccion). Autor unico independiente, reporte v3 que corrige comparaciones cruzadas erroneas de v1/v2 (Sec.0 Changelog) -- RECONSIDERAR (autopublicacion sin baseline externo re-evaluado en la misma variante).

title: Cabrera et al. (2026). Communication Compression Memory Management and Cooperative Reasoning in Multi-Agent Systems.
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR -- published in a low-selectivity outlet (IJICTT), 3 of 4 authors share the first name 'Noah', all benchmark numbers are suspiciously round with no variance reported and no code/artifact link is given; treat as unverified and weight accordingly.

title: Iscan (2026). Learning When to Remember: Risk-Sensitive Contextual Bandits for Abstention-Aware Memory Retrieval in LLM-Based Coding Agents.
senal_calidad: Ancla de evidencia: Abstract y Sec.3.1 (evaluation boundary, artefactos smoke-scale deterministicos), Tabla 1 (16-feature state), Ec.12-22 (recompensa y score). Autor unico, evaluacion local/proxy explicitamente acotada (no despliegue online causal con LLM) -- RECONSIDERAR (evidencia smoke-scale, no full-scale).

title: Iscan (2026). Feedback-Normalized Developer Memory for Reinforcement-Learning Coding Agents: A Safety-Gated MCP Architecture.
senal_calidad: Numeros en Abstract y Tabla 1/5 (Sec 3.1); autor unico (Iscan) con auto-reportada honestidad de limitaciones (RECONSIDERAR: patron de un mismo autor reapareciendo en el corpus con papers muy matematizados de dudosa revision por pares, verificar independencia editorial).

title: Sidik, B. y Rokach, L. (2026). MEMTIER: Tiered Memory Architecture and the Retrieval Bottleneck in Long-Running LLM Agents.
senal_calidad: Table 2 ablation (p.5-6) + §4.1 dense-retrieval baseline + §4.4 PPO trainer (p.7) are the load-bearing measurements. Not RECONSIDERAR.
